description: Tao's proof connects Collatz dynamics to a two-dimensional renewal process. Renewal times correspond to local minima in the trajectory. This bridges renewal theory, p-adic analysis, and number theory.
mathematical_formalization: Syracuse map induces descent times tau_1, tau_2, ... between local minima. By Tao's analysis, tau_i behave like i.i.d. random variables on Z/3^n Z. Total delay D(n) ~ sum_{i=1}^{R(n)} tau_i where R(n) is renewal count.
analogical_connections: Poisson process in queuing theory: trajectory as queue of descents
Molecular motor renewal theory in biology
Seismic renewal models for earthquake recurrence
implementation_hypothesis: Decompose trajectories into renewal segments at local minima. Fit segment length distribution. Predict total delay from first few segments.
experiment_seed: Compute renewal decompositions for 10,000 random numbers. Test if segment lengths are approximately i.i.d.
